## What changes and why

Describe the research value, correction, documentation improvement, or tooling fix.
For source changes, give the canonical URL and suggested category.

## Evidence and limitations

Link the public publisher documentation, methodology, and license/access terms you
checked, with the check date. Explain important limitations. Use "not applicable" for
changes that do not alter source claims.

## Affiliation and authorship

Disclose ownership, employment, sponsorship, referral relationships, and material AI
assistance, or say none. Identify adapted material and its license/permission.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material under LICENSING.md: CC BY 4.0 for content and MIT for code; required third-party notices are preserved.
- [ ] My descriptions are original, factual, and free of affiliate links or unsupported claims.
- [ ] For new URLs, I added explicit creation dates without changing existing dates and regenerated the catalog index (or this is not applicable).
- [ ] I updated related source-audit/matrix rows where applicable.
- [ ] I ran the checks in contributing.md, or explained below which checks I need help with.
- [ ] I included no credentials, private records, downloaded datasets, or unrelated changes.

## Validation or help needed

List results, or tell us what you could not run. New contributors can ask for help.
